reasoning: Anchor: last $264.58, 47% realized vol, down ~20% YoY and ~36% off the 52w high. Fundamentals are improving (Q2 adj EPS $2.55 beat, 2026 guide raised to $11.50-12.50, 920MW new nuclear PPAs, consensus 2027 EPS $13.34, ~26% growth), and independent writers (Reaves client letter via TIKR, Substack analyses) frame the Sept drop as technical supply from Calpine sellers. Against that, the macro is hostile: Polymarket prices a ~67% October Fed hike and ~97% no cut in 2026, the 10y is ~5.2%, and nuclear stocks broadly have de-rated in 2026. Hyperscaler capex trackers still show 2027 growth (~$820B-$1T), supporting demand but with overbuild debate. Valuation: P/E 19x on horizon NTM EPS ~$14.8 = $281, FCF-yield 6% on ~$17.3/sh = $288; blended ~$284, about +7% from spot, consistent with the scenario-weighted $285. I set a lognormal-like distribution with median ~$278 and annualized sigma ~40% (below realized 47%, which was inflated by the overhang episode, but above a typical large-cap given rate and AI-narrative sensitivity), giving P(>=265)~0.545. Tails: meaningful mass below $185 (~15%) for a rates/AI-bust combo; ~10% above $463 requires a strong re-rating.
